docs.snippet: /** 1.2: emit a `raise` node + a `raises` edge (proc → raise) carrying the full guard chain, + a

action.expr: const id = this.ctx.idFor('raise', { file: this.path, line });

this.nodes.push({
      id,
      kind: 'raise',
      name,
      ...(errorMessage ? { errorMessage } : {}),
      file: this.path,
      span: { start: line, end: line },
      lang: 'go',
      hash: this.ctx.hash(`${this.path}:${line}:raise:${name}:${errorMessage}`),
      meta: { inLoop, inException },
    });

this.edges.push({
      id: edgeId(proc.procId, id, 'raises'),
      src: proc.procId,
      dst: id,
      rel: 'raises',
      method: 'static',
      provenance: 'EXTRACTED',
      confidence: 1,
      evidence: { by: 'lang:go', snippet: name },
      cfgPath: guardStack.slice(),
      ...(guard !== undefined ? { guard } : {}),
      ...(guard !== undefined && branch !== undefined ? { branch } : {}),
      inLoop,
      inException,
    });
